newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow on Wednesday, with slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 4,800 slaughter steers and 4,500 slaughter heifers. Week to date 35,200 head confirmed including 16300 head or about 46 percent of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.00-64.25; few Select and Choice 1325-1375 lbs Holsteins 57.00-59.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 1250 lbs 103.00, hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1225 lbs 64.00-64.25. Few Commercial to Choice 1140-1200 lbs heifer and heiferettes 63.00-63.50.
Wk to date - 35,200 last week - 79,900 last year - 56,100
